actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in qemu in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and block until it is ready.
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
Port 6665 must accept telnet connections locally
Connection should present a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or boot command output as sufficient
Stopping after launching QEMU without confirming the telnet service is ready
Using a different port or non-telnet-accessible interface
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and filesystem for the ISO and qemu availability
Launch qemu with serial/console redirected to TCP port 6665 in the background
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observable
Record receipt-backed evidence of the running process and ready telnet prompt
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing qemu started with /app/alpine.iso and port 6665 forwarding
Receipt showing localhost:6665 is reachable and displays a login prompt
